newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Iansa cut to market perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Iansa cut to market perform.

text.p: -- Santander Investment analyst Heinrich Lessau has cut his rating for Chile's Industria Azucarera Nacional SA, or Iansa, to market perform from buy, according to a research report from Santander.

-- He cut the rating because of reduced sugar production and because the shares were trading close to their historic discount to the Santiago exchange's IPSA index, or 30 percent, according to the report.
-- The 12- to 18-month target price was cut to 90 pesos, 15.4 percent above current levels, from 112 pesos.
-- The company's shares were up 0.74 peso to 76.25 peso in Santiago.
